title: Subxiphoid needle geometry (no-ultrasound fallback)
view: Supine male chest and upper abdomen from above, the patient's right on the image left, the rib cage drawn over it; inset: sagittal section, head to the right, skin at the top (not to scale).
teachingPoint: Blind fallback only: enter 1 cm below the left costal margin beside the xiphoid, stay shallow under the margin at 30-45 degrees, and aim at the left shoulder.
claims: Entry zone 1 cm below the left costal margin, just left of the xiphoid (record).
Dashed arrow from the entry toward the left shoulder (record).
Inset: needle at about 35 degrees to the skin (record: 30-45), passing under the costal cartilage into the pericardial effusion (record: tracks shallowly under the costal margin).
Rib cage, xiphoid and costal margins drawn over the approved decompression torso photo (reused).
Labels: Xiphoid, Entry site, Toward left shoulder, 30–45°, Effusion.
